sokkel-egui.note: Drawn from the spec: the method at 500, the path cut with the whole on hover, href and the copy button.

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: A small chip naming the request behind a screen, its method and path: GET /api/jobs/nightly-export. A press on its copy button copies the method and the path (or the app's own value, such as a curl line); with href the path is a link to the API's reference or the raw response; with open the whole chip is one link that opens the address in a new tab. The method is quiet for a read, in the warning ink for a write and in the critical ink for a delete.

anatomy.chip: The chip: 24 tall, on a faint muted wash with a border edge, rounded by radius-chip, 8 in at its start; the method, the path, then the copy button at its end, 6 apart. As wide as it needs, at most its room.
anatomy.method: The method in capitals, in the code face at text.xs and 450: muted-foreground for a read (GET and the rest), warning-ink for POST, PUT and PATCH, critical-ink for DELETE.
anatomy.path: The path in the code face at text.xs, cut to its room with its whole text on hover. With href, a link: underlined under the pointer, an arrow after it.
anatomy.copy: parts/button's icon-xs copy button (CopyButton), naming words.copy and saying words.copied once pressed.
anatomy.arrow: With open, an arrow up and right after the path, 12 square, in muted-foreground, standing for the new tab.

method.does: The request's method, drawn in capitals.

href.does: Makes the path a link that opens in a new tab: the API's reference or the raw response.

copyValue.does: What the copy button copies in place of the method and the path, such as the full address or a curl line.

open.does: The whole chip is one link that opens href (or the path) in a new tab, padded 8 at both ends, in place of the copy button.

chip.note: 8 in at the start (layout.chipStart); with open 8 at the end too, else the copy button ends it.

chipStart.note: The chip's padding before the method.

rest.means: A read: the method in the quiet ink.

write.means: A write: the method in the warning ink.

delete.means: A delete: the method in the critical ink.

hover.means: The pointer is over the chip (open) or the path (href).

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the chip (open) or the path (href): the focus outline.

rest.note: In the code face, in the ink of what it stands on.

keyboard.does: Reaches the path when it is a link, then the copy button; with open, the chip.
Opens the address in a new tab.
keyboard.when: the path or the chip (open) has focus

keyboard.does: Copies the request; the button says words.copied a moment.

appText.copyValue: What the copy button copies, when not the method and the path.

sokkel-ui: A link opens with target _blank; with open, words.opens is said after the path to a screen reader only.
The copy button is CopyButton, the library's one; it takes the chip's copy and copied.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
